title: Zero bleaching accounted for 996 of 1,052 exact depth matches in Reef Check surveys from 1998 to 2019
abstract: Zero values accounted for 996 of 1,052 exact depth matches (94.7%). We audited exact agreement between reported bleaching percentages at two depths. We used 1,683 Reef Check site-date pairs at 984 sites from BCO-DMO 773466 version 2. Depths were 1-20 m and differed by at least 3 m. Of 367 pairs with two positive values, 56 (15.3%) had identical values. We compared this rate across oceans and two time periods, and with random depth pairing within ocean and year. This is an audit of selected records. Agreement can reflect shared ecological exposure, rounding, common reporting, or other causes. It cannot identify these causes or prove equal biological responses. The package gives code, paired records, provenance, checks, and a figure.
